description: Create three new API route files for the Mode A server-side flow: file upload, file matching, and campaign activation. Depends on FEAT-001 (campaign must be created as 'draft' for activation logic to make sense). Independent of FEAT-003 (wizard UI).
steps: 1. Create src/routes/api/campaigns/[id]/files/+server.ts. POST handler. Auth: requireSession try/catch. Ownership check: query campaigns with .eq('id', params.id).eq('user_id', session.user.id) and verify mode === 'A' and status === 'draft'. Import createSupabaseAdminClient from '$lib/server/db/supabase'. Import JSZip from 'jszip'. Parse request.formData(). For each FormData entry that is a File object: if mime_type is 'application/zip' or filename ends '.zip', load with JSZip (const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(await file.arrayBuffer())), iterate zip.files filtering !file.dir, extract each as uint8array (await zipFile.async('uint8array')); else treat file buffer as-is. For each extracted file: if mime_type is 'image/gif' or 'image/tiff' or filename ends .gif/.tif/.tiff, push an error entry and skip (do not fail the whole batch, collect errors). Determine mime_type from the file's detected type or extension mapping (pdf→application/pdf, png→image/png, jpg/jpeg→image/jpeg, webp→image/webp, docx→application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document). Upload to admin.storage.from('documents').upload(`${session.user.id}/${params.id}/${filename}`, buffer, { contentType: mimeType, upsert: true }). On storage error, collect error and continue. Insert document_assets row via admin client: { user_id: session.user.id, workspace_id: null, name: filename, storage_path: uploadPath, file_size: buffer.byteLength, mime_type: mimeType, metadata: { campaign_id: params.id } }. After processing all files, return { success: true, data: { assets: successfulAssets, errors: errorList } }. If zero files succeeded and errors exist, return 422.

2. Create src/routes/api/campaigns/[id]/match/+server.ts. POST handler accepting JSON body { match_column: string }. Auth: requireSession try/catch. Validate body with zod: z.object({ match_column: z.string().min(1) }). Ownership check: query campaigns (id, mode, status, user_id). Load all campaign_recipients for this campaign: .select('id, variables').eq('campaign_id', params.id). Load all document_assets where metadata contains this campaign_id: use .select('id, name').filter('metadata->>campaign_id', 'eq', params.id). Use createSupabaseAdminClient for the document_assets query (bypasses RLS since assets are user-scoped but filter is on metadata). Build match map: const assetMap = new Map<string, string>() where key = asset.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '').trim().toLowerCase(), value = asset.id. For each recipient, compute recipientKey = String(recipient.variables[match_column] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(). If assetMap.has(recipientKey), record as match. Build upsert array. Upsert into file_matches via admin client: .upsert(matches, { onConflict: 'campaign_id,campaign_recipient_id' }). Track unmatched asset names (asset keys with no matching recipient). Return { success: true, data: { total_assets: assetMap.size, matched: matches.length, unmatched: unmatchedFiles.length, unmatched_files: unmatchedFiles } }.

3. Create src/routes/api/campaigns/[id]/activate/+server.ts. POST handler. Auth: requireSession try/catch. Ownership check: query campaigns (id, mode, status, user_id). Verify mode === 'A' and status === 'draft', return 422 if not. Count file_matches for this campaign using admin client: .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('campaign_id', params.id).eq('is_excluded', false). If count === 0, return 422 { error: 'No file matches found. Upload and match files before activating.' }. Update campaign status: .update({ status: 'queued' }).eq('id', params.id). Update delivery_jobs: .update({ status: 'queued' }).eq('campaign_id', params.id).eq('status', 'draft'). Enqueue jobs: query delivery_jobs for this campaign with status='queued', then call pgmq_send_batch with their ids (same pattern as src/routes/api/campaigns/[id]/start/+server.ts). Return { success: true }.
acceptance_criteria: npm run check passes with zero errors on all three new files
POST /api/campaigns/{id}/files accepts multipart FormData and uploads files to Supabase documents bucket at {user_id}/{campaign_id}/{filename}
POST /api/campaigns/{id}/files extracts ZIP contents individually (jszip already in dependencies)
POST /api/campaigns/{id}/files rejects GIF and TIFF files with a clear error in the errors array
POST /api/campaigns/{id}/match matches files to recipients by comparing (filename without extension, trimmed, lowercase) against recipient variables[match_column]
POST /api/campaigns/{id}/activate returns 422 if no file_matches exist for the campaign
POST /api/campaigns/{id}/activate transitions campaign and delivery_jobs from 'draft' to 'queued' and enqueues jobs
verification: npm run check — must report 0 errors
findings: 1. JSZip async API: used JSZip.loadAsync(arrayBuffer) to open the archive, then iterated Object.entries(zip.files) skipping entries where zipFile.dir===true, extracting each via zipFile.async('uint8array'). ZIP basenames are extracted with .split('/').pop() to discard nested path prefixes. 2. Admin client import: createSupabaseAdminClient is exported from '$lib/server/db/supabase' and called once per request (not per file) to avoid repeated client instantiation. 3. document_assets metadata: campaign_id is stored as metadata: { campaign_id: params.id } since the table has no campaign_id column. The match endpoint queries this field via .filter('metadata->>campaign_id', 'eq', id) using Supabase PostgREST JSON path syntax. 4. Blocked MIME types: GIF and TIFF are rejected at the processFile helper level (not at the request level) so that the rest of the batch can still succeed; errors are collected and returned alongside successful uploads. 5. file_matches upsert: uses onConflict: 'campaign_id,campaign_recipient_id' as specified; only new matches are written (no is_confirmed/is_excluded overwrite on re-match). 6. activate enqueue pattern: mirrors start/+server.ts exactly — update delivery_jobs to 'queued', fetch them back, call pgmq_send_batch wrapped in Promise.resolve().catch() so a queue failure is non-fatal.
